description: Check a Swift project for security defects: hardcoded API keys, tokens, and passwords in source; credentials written to UserDefaults instead of the Keychain; App Transport Security disabled; cleartext http:// endpoints; TLS server trust accepted without evaluation; MD5 and SHA-1; Keychain items with over-permissive accessibility; non-cryptographic randomness used for nonces and salts; secrets written to logs; and string interpolation into evaluated JavaScript. Use before shipping, during a security review, or when handling credentials.

path.description: Absolute path to the Swift project root (the folder containing Package.swift or the .xcodeproj).

name: review_swift_security

score.description: 0-100 defect density. 100 = no findings. penalty = 10*blockers + 3*serious + 1*minor; capacity = files*10. Comparable across runs on ONE project, not between projects.

suggestions.description: Prioritized next actions, deduplicated by rule — not a restatement of every issue's fix.

title: Review iOS security
